arxiv-1812-02472.title: The binary method of integer decomposition and its application
arxiv-1812-02472.creator: Puyun Gao
arxiv-1812-02472.description: Abstract This paper presents an integer decomposition method. The method first writes an integer as a polynomial with 2 as variable that its coefficients are zero or one. Then, suppose that an integer is decomposed into product of such two polynomials that their orders are greater than one.

arxiv-2106-01038.title: Background Independence and Quantum Causal Structure
arxiv-2106-01038.creator: L. Parker, F. Costa
arxiv-2106-01038.description: Abstract One of the key ways in which quantum mechanics differs from general relativity is that it requires a fixed background reference frame for spacetime. In fact, this appears to be one of the main conceptual obstacles to uniting the two theories. Additionally, a combination of the two theories is expected to yield ‘indefinite’ causal structures.

arxiv-2111-12777.title: ASYMPTOTIC CYCLES IN FRACTIONAL MAPS OF ARBITRARY POSITIVE ORDERS
arxiv-2111-12777.creator: Mark Edelman 1, Avigayil B. Helman 2
arxiv-2111-12777.description: Abstract Many natural (biological, physical, etc.) and social systems possess power-law memory, and their mathematical modeling requires application of discrete and continuous fractional calculus. Most of these systems are nonlinear and demonstrate regular and chaotic behavior, which may be very different from the behavior of memoryless systems.

arxiv-2201-06075.title: Time-reversal symmetry breaking in frustrated superconductor Re 2 Hf
arxiv-2201-06075.creator: Manasi Mandal, Anshu Kataria, Chandan Patra, D. Singh, P. K. Biswas, A. D. Hillier, Tanmoy Das, R. P. Singh
arxiv-2201-06075.description: Abstract Geometrical frustration leads to novel quantum phenomena such as the spin-liquid phase in triangular and Kagomé lattices. Intra-band and inter-band Fermi surface (FS) nesting can drive unique superconducting (SC) ground states with d d -wave and s ± s^{\pm} pairing symmetries, respectively, according to the criterion that the SC gap changes sign across the nesting wavevector.

arxiv-2202-13706.title: Monkey Business: Reinforcement learning meets neighborhood search for Virtual Network Embedding
arxiv-2202-13706.creator: Maxime Elkael, Massinissa Ait aba, Andrea Araldo, Hind Castel-Taleb, Badii Jouaber
arxiv-2202-13706.description: Abstract In this article, we consider the Virtual Network Embedding (VNE) problem for 5G networks slicing. This problem requires to allocate multiple Virtual Networks (VN) on a substrate virtualized physical network while maximizing among others, resource utilization, maximum number of placed VNs and network operator’s benefit. We solve the online version of the problem where slices arrive over time.

arxiv-2310-11502.title: Modeling Post-Reionization HI Distributions in Fuzzy Dark Matter Cosmologies Using Conditional Normalizing Flows 2023 Modeling Post-Reionization HI Distributions in Fuzzy Dark Matter Cosmologies Using Conditional Normalizing Flows – A.3
arxiv-2310-11502.creator: Tibor Dome, Rumail Azhar, Anastasia Fialkov
arxiv-2310-11502.description: Abstract Upcoming 21 cm intensity mapping experiments like the Square Kilometer Array (SKA) hold significant potential to constrain the properties of dark matter. In this work, we model neutral hydrogen (HI) distributions using high-resolution hydrodynamical N N -body simulations of both cold dark matter (CDM) and fuzzy dark matter (FDM) cosmologies in the post-reionization redshift range of z = 3.

arxiv-2504-06187.title: Scaling Invariance: A Gateway to Phase Transitions
arxiv-2504-06187.creator: Edson D. Leonel
arxiv-2504-06187.description: Abstract We explore the concept of scaling invariance in a type of dynamical systems that undergo a transition from order (regularity) to disorder (chaos). The systems are described by a two-dimensional, nonlinear mapping that preserves the area in the phase space. The key variables are the action and the angle, as usual from Hamiltonian systems.

arxiv-2507-16765.title: Elliptic Curves, Riordan arrays and Lattice Paths
arxiv-2507-16765.description: Abstract In this note, we show that to each elliptic curve of the form y 2 − a ​ x ​ y − y = x 3 − b ​ x 2 − c ​ x , y^{2}-axy-y=x^{3}-bx^{2}-cx, we can associate a family of lattice paths whose step set is determined by the parameters of the elliptic curve.

arxiv-2508-19503.title: Curves in projective space and RSK
arxiv-2508-19503.creator: Carl Lian, Saskia Solotko
arxiv-2508-19503.description: Abstract . The geometric Tevelev degrees of projective space enumerate general, pointed algebraic curves interpolating through the maximal possible number of points. Previous work expresses these invariants in terms of Schubert calculus. Extending ideas of Gillespie–Reimer-Berg, we use the RSK correspondence to give a positive interpretation of these counts in terms of the combinatorics of words. August 10, 2026 1.

arxiv-2511-17194.title: Steering in the Shadows: Causal Amplification for Activation Space Attacks in Large Language Models
arxiv-2511-17194.creator: Zhiyuan Xu, Stanislav Abaimov, Joseph Gardiner, Sana Belguith
arxiv-2511-17194.description: Abstract Modern large language models (LLMs) are typically secured by auditing data, prompts, and refusal policies, while treating the forward pass as an implementation detail. We show that intermediate activations in decoder-only LLMs form a vulnerable attack surface for behavioral control.

arxiv-2601-22525.title: Group Sequential Methods for the Win Ratio
arxiv-2601-22525.creator: Tracy Bergemann, Tim Hanson
arxiv-2601-22525.description: Abstract The win ratio is increasingly used in randomized trials due to its intuitive clinical interpretation, ability to incorporate the relative importance of composite endpoints, and its capacity for combining different types of outcomes (e.g. time-to-event, binary, counts, etc.) to be combined.

pmc-10602290.title: Identification of immune-related signatures and pathogenesis differences between thoracic aortic aneurysm patients with bicuspid versus tricuspid valves via weighted gene co-expression network analysis
pmc-10602290.creator: Min Huang, Rong Guan, Jiawei Qiu, Abla Judith Estelle Gnamey, Yusi Wang, Hai Tian, Haoran Sun, Hongbo Shi, Wenjing Sun, Xueyuan Jia, Jie Wu, Stephen Allen Ramsey, Stephen Allen Ramsey, Stephen Allen Ramsey
pmc-10602290.description: BackgroundThoracic aortic aneurysm (TAA) occurs due to pathological aortal dilation, and both individuals with normal tricuspid aortic valves (TAV) or abnormal bicuspid aortic valves (BAV), the latter being a congenital condition, are at risk. However, some differences are present between TAA/BAV and TAA/TAV with respect to their pathophysiological processes and molecular mechanisms, but their exact nature is still mostly unknown.

pmc-10643594.title: Latin American young patients with gastric adenocarcinoma: worst prognosis and outcomes
pmc-10643594.creator: Germán Calderillo-Ruíz, María Consuelo Díaz-Romero, Berenice Carbajal-López, Marytere Herrera-Martínez, Erika Ruiz-García, Alberto M. Leon-Takahashi, Horacio Noé López-Basave, Abelardo Meneses-García, Ángel Herrera-Gomez
pmc-10643594.description: BackgroundIncidence of young patients (aged 40 years or younger) diagnosed with gastric carcinoma has increased worldwide. Young GC diagnosis, have clinicopathological features that differ from elderly, and is correlated with bad prognosis factors. The purpose of this work is to describe the prevalence, clinic-pathological features, and prognosis of overall survival (OS) of young Latin-American patients with GC.MethodsRetrospective, observational study.

pmc-10661244.title: The Tomosynthesis Broken Halo Sign: Diagnostic Utility for the Classification of Newly Diagnosed Breast Tumors
pmc-10661244.creator: Johannes Deeg, Michael Swoboda, Daniel Egle, Verena Wieser, Afschin Soleiman, Valentin Ladenhauf, Malik Galijasevic, Birgit Amort, Silke Haushammer, Martin Daniaux, Leonhard Gruber
pmc-10661244.description: Background: Compared to conventional 2D mammography, digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT) offers greater breast lesion detection rates. Ring-like hypodense artifacts surrounding dense lesions are a common byproduct of DBT. This study’s purpose was to assess whether minuscule changes spanning this halo—termed the “broken halo sign”—could improve lesion classification. Methods: This retrospective study was approved by the local ethics review board.

pmc-12504912.title: Association Between Digestive Diseases, Nighttime Sleep, and Depressive Symptoms Among the Middle‐Aged and Elderly Adults: A Mediation Analysis
pmc-12504912.creator: Congcong Cheng, Dinghui Guo, Xu Cao, Dingmin Wang, Wenling Li, Bei Miao, Sujuan Fei
pmc-12504912.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveTo explore the mediating effect of nighttime sleep duration between digestive diseases and depressive symptoms among middle‐aged and elderly adults, so as to guide clinical intervention and treatment of depression related to digestive diseases.MethodsBased on the data of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS) from 2015 to 2020, difference analysis, Spearman correlation analysis, and multivariate logistic regression were conducted to analyze the relationships among digestive diseases, nighttime sleep duration, and depressive symptoms.

pmc-12526398.title: Efficacy of Nanofiber Sheets Incorporating Oxaliplatin in Gastrointestinal Cancer Xenograft Models
pmc-12526398.creator: Fusao Sumiyama, Hoang Hai Duong, Hideyuki Matsushima, Kosuke Matsui, Terufumi Yoshida, Hidekazu Yamamoto, Hisashi Kosaka, Mitsugu Sekimoto, Van Khanh Nguyen, Thanh Tung Lai, Takuya Ohigashi, Tomoya O. Akama, Kengo Yoshii, Emiho Oe, Nanami Fujisawa, Mitsuhiro Ebara, Masaki Kaibori
pmc-12526398.description: Oxaliplatin is an anticancer drug used to treat colorectal and gastric cancers. In many cases, chemotherapy is discontinued due to adverse events caused by anticancer drugs. To address this challenge, we developed a sustained-release drug delivery system using polycaprolactone sheets embedded with oxaliplatin (oxaliplatin sheets) and evaluated their therapeutic potential in murine models of colon and gastric cancers.

pmc-12548255.title: The feasibility of a set of physical resilience measurements in older patients admitted to the acute medical unit
pmc-12548255.creator: K. D. J. Bos, J. A. H. R. Claassen, F. H. Bosch, C. J. M. Doggen, S. J. H. Bredie, R. J. F. Melis
pmc-12548255.description: BackgroundMost patients admitted to the Acute Medical Unit (AMU) are 60 years and older, have several multimorbidities, and are frail. During the short AMU stay, it can be challenging to determine whether these patients can recover safely at home or require an extended hospital stay.

pmc-12622687.title: The causal relationship between atopic dermatitis and retinal detachment: A 2-sample Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-12622687.creator: Xiazhen Liu, Hong Li, Taoran Tang, Yaqi Zhu, Shilin Zhu
pmc-12622687.description: A 2-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was employed to determine the causal relationship between atopic dermatitis (AD) and retinal detachment (RD). Data related to AD and RD were retrieved from genome-wide association study databases, from which independent single nucleotide polymorphisms were selected as instrumental variables. MR analyses were performed using methods including inverse variance weighting, MR-Egger, and weighted median.
